• Analyze the differences between using a simple if statement, a nested if -else and an if- else-if ladder in C. In what scenarios is each one useful? Support your answer with examples. [An] [3] Explain each with syntax and examples. Give 2 marks for simple if and 4 marks each for nested if and if else if ladder
  • • Simple if: Suitable for single conditions. Example: if (x > 0) printf("Positive");
  • • Nested if-else: Suitable for hierarchical conditions. Example: Example: if (a>b) { if (a>c) printf("A is greater"); else printf("C is greater"); } else if (b>c) printf("B is greater"); else printf("C is greater");
  • • If-else-if ladder: Useful for multi-way branching. Example: Example: if (x > 0) printf("Positive"); else if (x < 0) printf("Negative"); else printf("Zero");
